channel.title: HelpScout incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from HelpScout's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Mailbox counts [resolved]
item.description: Inbox behavior (Conversation Counts, SLAs, Routing, and Sentiment issue) is stable across the board, so we're closing this out. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this one!

item.title: App Access Issues [resolved]
item.description: Inbox and AI Draft behavior is stable across the board, so we're closing this out. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this one!

item.title: Beacon Issues [resolved]
item.description: Live Chat behavior is stable across the board, so we're closing this out. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this one!

item.title: SLA issues [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved and the SLA feature is now running smoothly. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Report Loading [resolved]
item.description: Engineers have confirmed queues have drained and Reports behavior is stable across the board, so we're closing this out. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this one!

item.title: Delays with Inbox counts, folders, reports and search results [resolved]
item.description: Folder counts and updates in your Inbox should be working as expected again! Thanks for your patience today folks, we're going to close this one out.

item.title: Docs Errors [resolved]
item.description: Help Scout Docs is fully operational - we’re closing this out. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this one!

item.title: App Access Issues [resolved]
item.description: Access issues have been fully resolved, and this incident is now closed. Sorry for any inconvenience this caused, and thank you for your patience.

item.title: Automatic Workflows not running [resolved]
item.description:
Between ~05:06–12:46 UTC some conversations were not processed by automatic workflows, as a result some conversations may not have expected automated actions performed on them.
The issue is now resolved and automatic workflows are working normally. Affected conversations will require manual action(s) to be taken.
If you'd like extra support, please email our team: help@helpscout.com

item.title: Delays with report exports [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Report exports are processing normally again. If you continue to experience issues, please email us at help@helpscout.com, and we'll investigate. Thank you for your patience today.

item.title: Global Search Slowness [resolved]
item.description: This issue has been resolved. Global search and tag management are performing normally again. We're sorry for the disruption this caused. If you're still experiencing issues, please email help@helpscout.com, and we'd be happy to assist. Again, thank you for your patience while we got to the bottom of this.

item.title: Inbound Email Delay and Sluggish Behavior Across Help Scout [resolved]
item.description: Alright folks, all services are stable so we're closing this out. Thanks for your patience and apologies for the disruption today!

item.title: Docs and AI Answers Issues [resolved]
item.description: Resolved - The loading issues with AI Answers and Docs have been resolved, so we're closing this out. Sorry for the interruption today, folks!

item.title: Connection Issues [resolved]
item.description: Our team has identified and resolved the issue, and performance is now stable across the board. We'll continue to monitor all services over the next few hours. Thank you for your patience while we resolved this.

item.title: AI Feature Issue [resolved]
item.description: Thanks for your patience today folks. This issue has been resolved an all AI features should be functioning normally again. Apologies for the disruption!

item.title: Connection Issues [resolved]
item.description: The team has confirmed that the access issues have been fully resolved, and this incident is now closed. Thank you again for your patience!

item.title: AI Drafts: Intermittent issues generating AI Drafts [resolved]
item.description: Our team found and resolved the issue, and AI Drafts are generating drafts again. Thanks for bearing with us today, folks!

item.title: Reporting Views Displaying Inconsistent Metrics [resolved]
item.description: Our team has resolved this issue. You should no longer see inconsistent reporting metrics or any issues with reporting views. Apologies for the disruption today, folks!

item.title: Inbound Email Issues [resolved]
item.description: It looks like the issue at Google has been resolved, so inbound emails forwarded to Help Scout from Google accounts should now be working as normal once again. If you do run into any further issues, just reach out to let us know.

item.title: Outbound Email and Draft Creation Issues [resolved]
item.description: Resolved - Our team has identified and resolved the issue. Outbound emails are being delivered again. Sorry for the trouble today, everyone.

item.description: We can confirm that views and folders have been operating as expected today, and that the underlying issue here has been resolved. Please get in touch with our team if you continue to experience any unusual behavior across your inbox.

item.title: Docs Errors [resolved]
item.description: Help Scout Docs and AI Answers are fully operational - we’re closing this out. Thank you for your patience while we worked on this one!

item.title: Drafts Not Loading Properly [resolved]
item.description: Our engineers have fixed the issue preventing drafts from opening properly, and you should now be able to edit all of the drafts in your inbox. Thanks for your patience while we worked on getting this one fixed up!

item.title: Closed Folder Issues [resolved]
item.description: Our engineers have found the issue causing Closed Conversations not to display in the Closed Folder, and this has now been resolved, You should now find all of those Conversations in the Closed Folder as normal. Thanks for your patience while we worked on getting this one fixed up!

item.title: Sidebar Apps loading intermittently [resolved]
item.description: We've monitored the fix we implemented and sidebar apps are now loading. Thanks for your patience as we investigated and fixed this issue.

item.title: Sidebar Apps not loading [resolved]
item.description: After monitoring, it looks like sidebar apps are loading once more. It seems that the fix is working and we're going to close this one out!

item.title: Connections Issues [resolved]
